claim: A computer defeats the world chess champion.
originalWording: A computer defeats the world chess champion.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: A machine wins a standard match against the reigning world chess champion; either cited 1998 or 2000 deadline suffices.
reference.rationale: IBM documents Deep Blue’s 1997 match win, before both candidate deadlines. The outcome remains a full success. Resolving the edition changes only whether it was one or three years early.

evidence.title: IBM — Deep Blue
